senses.gloss: (h. h.; cmp. גאל)to be covered with impurity, be loathsome; to loathe. V. preced.
to remove impurity by means of hot water, to cleanse.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:12">Ab. Zar. V, 12</cite> <he>את שדרכו להַגְעִיל יַגְעִיל</he> a vessel which ordinarily is cleansed with hot water, must be purified for ritual purposes by means of hot water.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76a:17">Ib. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>כיצד מַגְעִילָן וכ׳</he> how must one disinfect them? You put a smaller vessel into a larger one &c.; a. fr.—Y. Ter. XI, 48ᵃ <he>מַגְעִילָהּ בחמין</he> removes the soakings of T’rumah &c. [Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ <he>שיגעיל</he>, read <he>משיעגל</he>, v. <cite ref="P00089"><he>עָגַל</he></cite>.] V. <cite ref="E00080"><he>הַגְעָלָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be removed through boiling. Y. Ter. l. c.
